# Standard Retail MRP Pricing Sticker Template

## Production Retail MRP Sticker Layout

Compliant with consumer protection and labeling regulations in Nepal and India.

### Standard Layout Component
```html
<div class="mrp-sticker" style="width: 63.5mm; height: 33.9mm; border: 1px dashed #ccc; padding: 2mm; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: sans-serif;">
  <div style="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden;">Himalayan Green Tea (100g)</div>
  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-top: 1mm;">
    <span style="font-size: 8pt; color: #555;">MRP (Incl. of all taxes):</span>
    <span style="font-size: 13pt; font-weight: 900; color: #000;">NPR 450.00</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 7.5pt; color: #333; margin-top: 1mm;">
    PKD: 09/2026 | BATCH: HGT-2609-B12
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 7pt; color: #666; margin-top: 0.5mm;">
    Mfd By: Sahara Bio Agro Labs, Chitwan
  </div>
</div>
```
Recommended SKU: **ST-24 A4100** (24 labels/sheet) or **ST-33 A4100** (33 labels/sheet).
